text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp begins today, and we'll be
training
hard at a campground near the
beach while we're
here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the perfect opportunity to polish up
Narita
Taishin's abilities before the
Kikuka Sho, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's just... As it is, I already don't get
much time to
myself living in the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
But at summer camp, I have negative
alone time,
and that's depressing as hell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she mentions it, I can see why
this
environment would be stressful for
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It won't do for Narita Taishin to continue
this
way, so I start thinking about how to
cheer her
up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there's seriously no one here. I
had no idea
this place existed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh. This might be a decent spot to nap
since it's
so quiet.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering why you were running
around
everywhere. Was it just to find a
place like this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Look, I go through this every year, so
don't waste
your time stressing out. I can
train perfectly well
without you being so
extra.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. Whatever. Just leave it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, don't we have training to do?
Are we
gonna get started or not?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's so freakin' hard to find the right time
to say
thanks...
